For the Petitioner : Mr. Shailesh, Advocate Mr. Abhijeet Kumar Singh, Advocate For the State : Mr.
Rakesh Ranjan, Addl.P.P ------
Order No.06 Dated- 15.05.2024 Heard learned counsel for the parties.

2. Apprehending his arrest in connection with Jharia (Boragarh) P.S. Case No. 26 of 2022 instituted under Sections 498-A and 326 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 3/4 of D.P. Act, the petitioner has moved this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the petitioner is innocent and has committed no offence at all rather he has been falsely implicated in this case due to matrimonial dispute between the parties.
After completion of investigation, charge-sheet has been submitted against the petitioner.
All the allegations levelled against the petitioner is entirely false and fabricated.
Petitioner undertakes to co-operate with the trial of the case.
Hence, the petitioner may be extended the privilege of anticipatory bail.

4. Learned Addl.P.P appearing for the State opposes the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner and submits that petitioner has poured boil milk over the informant causing severe burn injuries.
Whatever may be the reason of dispute between the parties, the conduct of the petitioner is not entitled for anticipatory bail.
Hence, petitioner may not be extended privilege of anticipatory bail.

5. It appears that the marriage of the informant was solemnized with the petitioner in the year 2021 and just after few days, the informant was subjected to cruelty both mentally and physically at the hands of petitioner and petitioner throw hot milk on the face of the informant due to which she sustained severe burn injuries and was hospitalized.
It further appears that after completion of investigation, charge-sheet has been submitted against the petitioner for the offence under section 498A and 326 of IPC and sections 3/4 of D.P. Act.

Considering the facts and circumstances of this case, the serious and heinous nature of offence committed by the petitioner of pouring hot milk over the informant causing severe burn injuries,
therefore, I do not feel inclined to extend the privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioner.
Accordingly, the prayer of anticipatory bail of petitioner is rejected.

(Pradeep Kumar Srivastava, J.) Pappu/
